name: Hatch Control
headerDisplay: Receiver controls for Hatch Rest, Rest+ and Mini; routine receivers for Restore/Baby. Controls vary by model. Use your Hatch account login.

soundIds.title: Sound IDs to expose (optional)
soundIds.description: Optional global filter for Rest-family sound IDs. IDs differ by model; leave unset for the full catalog on mixed-model setups. Does not filter Restore routines.
